subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential, scope, event-subscription, and config contract should be accepted?
rationale: Source review can prove the current service-account webhook path and mention gate do not satisfy the request, but the fix changes credential storage, consent/scopes, non-mentioned Space data visibility, subscription lifecycle, and fallback behavior.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

options.title: Limit Google Chat To Mentioned Webhooks
options.body: Keep the bundled plugin service-account and mention-triggered, while finishing thread-reply reliability separately and narrowing this issue's all-message portion out of scope.

options.title: Defer To Broader Workspace Auth
options.body: Hold this work until Google Workspace integrations share a common consent, token, event-subscription, and admin-approval model.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across the prior thread-reply landing, related OAuth review context, and recent Google Chat plugin refactors.
